subject: Next steps: BrightStreet rerank & embeddings comparison + latency targets
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Cho <anna@brightstreet.ai>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@brightstreet.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-02T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed experiments (rerank & embeddings)

Anna / Tom — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned: 

What we heard you care about:
- Retrieval accuracy (recall@K) for long-tail queries on your medical billing dataset
- Effective reranking that preserves precision at top-5 while keeping end-to-end latency under 120ms P95
- Cost per query / token for different vector dims and model families

Proposed experiments Redwood will run (we can run these on hosted or your Dedicated pool):
1) Baseline embedding comparison: 768-d vs 1536-d (open models + our quantized variants) — measure recall@10, recall@100, index size, and query cost.
2) Rerank microbench: run candidate generation (FAISS HNSW) + Redwood reranker (causal LLM pairwise rerank) — capture retrieval latency (P50/P95), total end-to-end latency, and recall@5/10.
3) Hyperscaler API comparison: same workload vs AWS Bedrock (embedded), Azure OpenAI endpoints — measure latency and token costs using identical prompts/contexts.

Data / artifacts we'll need from you to run a like-for-like test:
- Sample evaluation set (CSV) ~1k queries + ground-truth doc IDs (if you have relevance labels)
- Typical doc sizes and average candidate pool size (k) used today
- Any constraints on vector dims or index type (if you already use Pinecone/Weaviate)

Deliverables and timeline suggestion:
- Day 0: you share sample eval + security contact for data handling (SFTP or secure Drive link)
- Day 2–4: Redwood runs embeddings + rerank experiments and returns a results CSV + short analysis
- Day 5: Sync to review results and agree next steps (can be canary on Dedicated if you want to test throughput)

I've attached an evaluation checklist and the small CSV template we'll use to gather labels. If this plan looks good I'll kick off with Laura and Monica and we can schedule the Day 5 review.

Thanks,
Sergio
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
(redwood-onepager.pdf attached)

From: Anna Cho <anna@brightstreet.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@brightstreet.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-02T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed experiments (rerank & embeddings)

Thanks Sergio — this is exactly the level of detail we wanted. A few clarifications from our side:
- We have a labeled test set of ~1,250 queries with binary relevance; I'll upload a sample to a secure Drive link by EOD tomorrow.
- Our current embedding stack is 768-d using a hosted Pinecone index. We can try 1536-d if Redwood shows cost/latency tradeoffs.
- Our SLA target for production is 100ms P95, but for evaluation we're comfortable with up to 150ms P95 so we can explore options.

One ask: can you include a simple cost model (per-query USD) for each configuration (embedding dim + reranker model) so our finance folks can see ballpark numbers?

I'll send the sample and invite your security contact to the Drive share. Thanks — Anna
Director, Search & Retrieval | BrightStreet Analytics

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Cho <anna@brightstreet.ai>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-03T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed experiments (rerank & embeddings)

Anna — appreciate the quick confirm. We'll run the first round of tests on our hosted infra to give you an apples-to-apples benchmark, then we can repeat on Dedicated if you want to test throughput. Notes on what we'll report: 

- Retrieval metrics: recall@1/5/10/100, MRR
- Reranker metrics: precision@5/10, nDCG@10, pairwise win-rate vs baseline
- Latency: candidate generation P50/P95, reranker P50/P95, end-to-end P50/P95 (measured at client-side mock)
- Cost model: tokenized prompt + model cost + infra amortized per-query estimates for your projected qps (we'll show both hosted and Dedicated commit estimates)

Security and compliance: please CC security@brightstreet.ai on the Drive share and we'll ensure data access is locked to the evaluation job. Monica will reach out if we need an NDA amendment for sample data retention beyond 30 days.

I attached the evaluation checklist and the CSV template (brightstreet-mvp-eval-checklist.xlsx). We'll aim to deliver the first results by 2026-04-06 if we receive the sample by EOD 2026-04-03.

—Laura
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
(attachment: brightstreet-mvp-eval-checklist.xlsx)

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@brightstreet.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anna Cho <anna@brightstreet.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-05T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed experiments (rerank & embeddings)

Laura / Sergio — quick confirmation from our side: the Drive share is live at https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Bxyz (shared with security@redwood.ai). We've attached the eval CSV and a short doc describing our current index config (faiss-hnsw, ef=128).

Two additional asks before you run tests: 
- Please include a 1536->768 down-projection run (embedding dim 1536 stored, projected to 768 at query) so we can understand index-size vs quality tradeoff.
- In the hyperscaler comparison, please measure cold-start throughput for a 1-node scenario (simulating single-VM deployment) — we want to see realistic startup latency.

If you can stick to the proposed timeline (results by 2026-04-06), we'll book the 30-min review for 2026-04-07 10:00 PT.

Thanks — Tom
VP Search Engineering | BrightStreet Analytics
